Package com.netgrif.application.engine.petrinet.domain.roles

Interface ProcessRoleRepository

All Superinterfaces:
org.springframework.data.repository.CrudRepository<ProcessRole,String>, org.springframework.data.repository.ListCrudRepository<ProcessRole,String>, org.springframework.data.repository.ListPagingAndSortingRepository<ProcessRole,String>, org.springframework.data.mongodb.repository.MongoRepository<ProcessRole,String>, org.springframework.data.repository.PagingAndSortingRepository<ProcessRole,String>, org.springframework.data.repository.query.QueryByExampleExecutor<ProcessRole>, org.springframework.data.querydsl.QuerydslPredicateExecutor<ProcessRole>, org.springframework.data.repository.Repository<ProcessRole,String>
@Repository public interface ProcessRoleRepository extends org.springframework.data.mongodb.repository.MongoRepository<ProcessRole,String>, org.springframework.data.querydsl.QuerydslPredicateExecutor<ProcessRole>
Repository interface for managing ProcessRole entities in a MongoDB database. Extends MongoRepository for standard CRUD operations and QuerydslPredicateExecutor to support dynamic queries.
